document.title: Musharraf Accepts The Seven Points (Islamabad 05123)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), New Documents Detail America's Strategic Response to 9/11
document.note: [Secret] After meeting military commanders, Musharraf accepts the seven U.S. requested actions without conditions, though technical issues need clarification. He asks whether the U.S. aims to strike UBL or the Taliban too, urges a prompt economic recovery effort after any military action, and says Islamabad wants a friendly government in Kabul.

events.description: Musharraf met the US Ambassador and POLCOUNSELOR for about 90 minutes and accepted the seven US points without conditions. He had earlier discussed them with corps commanders.
Musharraf accepted the seven actions requested of the GOP in support of US efforts against international terrorism; his military leadership concurred.
U.S. Embassy Islamabad transmitted section 02 of cable 05123, 'Musharraf Accepts the Seven Points', to the State Department (DTG 142011Z SEP 01).
A speaker, apparently Musharraf, raised the political future of the Taliban and its supporters after any military action. The OCR is badly garbled and the speaker is not clear.
Musharraf meets the US Ambassador and Polcounselor for 90 minutes late in the day and says he accepts the seven points without conditions.
Musharraf holds an all-day meeting with his corps commanders and other senior military officers to discuss the US points.
Musharraf accepts the seven US requested actions without conditions; military leadership concurs; he invites a US interagency team to work out implementation details.

The U.S. Embassy Islamabad sent section 2 of 2 of cable 05123, 'Musharraf Accepts the Seven Points', to the State Department. The recoverable text raises the post-military-action political future of the Taliban and its supporters. The comment section notes that Musharraf and his military leadership are on board, but the OCR is largely illegible.
Musharraf met Ambassador Chamberlin and the Polcounselor for 90 minutes and accepted the seven points without conditions.
Musharraf held an all-day meeting with his corps commanders and senior officers to discuss the seven points; they concurred.
Musharraf accepted the seven US requests without conditions and invited an interagency team to work out the implementation details.

key_claims: Musharraf accepted without conditions the seven US requested actions for supporting the campaign against international terrorism.
Musharraf's corps commanders and other senior military officers concurred in the decision after an all-day meeting.
Musharraf invited the US to send an interagency team to work out remaining implementation details.
Musharraf raised the post-military-action political future of the Taliban and its supporters, suggesting Islamabad wanted a say in Afghanistan's future.
